title.zh: 检修灯为什么没有响应？
title.en: Why Did the Lamp Ignore the Signal?

brief.zh: 第一组要保留 HIGH 输入却隔离灯支路，第二组要让已停用的灯重新受 HIGH 信号控制。对照输入与开关状态完成工单。
brief.en: For the first order, keep the input HIGH while isolating the lamp. For the second, restore a disabled lamp so it lights under HIGH control. Check both the input and the switch.

concept.zh: 隔离负载与恢复信号控制
concept.en: Isolate the load and restore signal control

label.zh: 保留控制信号，切断灯支路
label.en: Isolate the lamp with the input active
